name: Eliakim
summary: The son of Hilkiah, who was over King Hezekiah's household. He spoke for the king when Rabshakeh came from Assyria to Jerusalem's wall.

key_moments.title: Speaks with Rabshakeh at the Wall
key_moments.description: Eliakim went out with Shebna and Joah to meet Rabshakeh and asked him to use Syrian, not the Jews' language, where the people on the wall could hear. Then, with torn clothes, they reported his words to Hezekiah.

key_moments.title: Sent to Isaiah
key_moments.description: Hezekiah sent Eliakim, Shebna and the senior priests, all in sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah. Isaiah sent back word from the LORD not to be afraid.

key_moments.title: Promised the Key of David's House
key_moments.description: The LORD called Eliakim His servant and said He would put the government into his hands. He would be like a father to Jerusalem and Judah, with the key of David's house laid on his shoulder.
